patches.name: Remove ads (APKS Installer)
patches.description: Disables all ads by forcing the master ads flag MyApplication.m to false and making the ad initializer a no-op. Verified on APKS Installer 2.8-Google.

patches.name: Unlock NetMonster Premium
patches.description: Activates NetMonster Premium and removes ads by forcing the local Adapty subscription checks to true and giving the premium card a real expiry date. Verified on NetMonster 5.3.1.

patches.name: Unlock SAI Premium
patches.description: Activates SAI Premium by forcing the local entitlement check to true in all three places that read it (ck0, fk0, dk0). Verified on SAI 2.4.3.
